verdict.rationale: Bruno ships an official, documented CLI (`bru`) that runs API collections from the command line. It produces JSON, JUnit and HTML reports and integrates with CI/CD pipelines. It also has official Docker images, runtime override flags such as `--global-env-var`, and a `--sandbox` mode switch, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, evidence of agent-oriented CLI workflows beyond running collections (e.g., creating or editing collections via CLI).
